t: What counts as having caught the prayer
a: مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الصُّبْحِ رَكْعَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الصُّبْحَ
p: Man adraka mina-ṣ-ṣubḥi rakʿatan qabla an taṭluʿa-sh-shamsu fa-qad adraka-ṣ-ṣubḥ
m: Whoever catches one unit of the dawn prayer before the sun rises has caught the dawn prayer.
